visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One Index Instead of Two
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Two index variables are advanced together in a while loop. Use one index and a for loop up to the shorter length, inside a zip function. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Both indexes always had the same value, so one is enough. Computing the length up front makes the stopping rule clear, and the function can be reused.
